scripts.dev: scripts/setup.sh && docker compose --project-directory "$(node -p 'process.cwd()')" -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up --build --watch
scripts.build:dotnet: pnpm restore:dotnet && dotnet build Xpathed.slnx --no-restore --configuration Release
scripts.check:dotnet: pnpm build:dotnet && pnpm format:check:dotnet && pnpm test:dotnet
scripts.check:tooling: pnpm format:check:tooling && pnpm lint:scripts && pnpm test:tooling
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:dotnet && pnpm lint:web && pnpm lint:scripts
scripts.lint:scripts: for script in scripts/*.sh; do sh -n "$script" || exit; done; for script in scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$script" || exit; done
scripts.test: pnpm test:dotnet && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:tooling
